newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kanzen Bhd rights proposal rejected.
newsitem.headline: Kanzen Bhd rights proposal rejected.

text.p: Kanzen Bhd said on Thursday that the Securities Commission (SC) has rejected its proposed rights issue but approved a planned bonus issue.
In a statement, Kanzen said it intends to appeal to SC to reconsider its decision.
The bonus and rights issues were related to planned acquisitions of some property.

Kanzen had previously proposed to acquire 100 percent equity in Karambunai Golf Holdings Sdn Bhd for 45 million ringgit, a 65.6 acre piece of land in central Negeri Sembilan state for 48 million ringgit and 116.1 acres of land in central Selangor state for 25 million ringgit.
The acquisitions were to have been satisfied in cash.
Kanzen had proposed a bonus issue of 28.387 million shares on a one-for-three basis and a rights issue of 85.162 million shares priced at 1.75 ringgit on a one-for-one basis.
Kanzen makes and distributes steel pipes and bedding products.
